name: Harpy
source: A girl of the bird people race. According to one legend, harpies are filthy monsters. but this one prefers being very clean. She also likes singing and aspires to become a diva. Her songs are laced with magic, and if you carelessly listen to them, your body will fall under a spell of pleasure and become unable to move.
